T3.4.message: p15 tandrā, p17 nidrā, p20 uṣṇam and p22 śītam are all made subjects of p29 asti, under yasya ('whose is no tiredness, no sleep, no heat, no cold'). That reading is grammatical. But gitapress-stotraratnavali.md splits the list differently. Its Hindi reads 'जो न पृथ्वी हैं … न तन्द्रा हैं, न निद्रा हैं, न ग्रीष्म हैं और न शीत हैं तथा जिनका न कोई देश है, न वेष है'. So tandrā, nidrā, grīṣma/uṣṇa and śīta describe what He is not, attached to x1/p13 āste, and only deśa, veṣa and mūrti go with yasya … asti. The data records no alternative for this split (w8.alternatives only covers how āste is read). A human should decide whether to keep this attachment and record the Gita Press split as an alternative (for example on w22), or the reverse.
T3.4.suggested_fix: Keep the current heads and add an alternative to words.w22 saying that gitapress-stotraratnavali takes tandrā, nidrā, grīṣma/uṣṇa and śīta as further things He is not (with yaḥ … āste), and only deśa, veṣa and mūrti with yasya … asti.
